name: gitlab-self-hosted
description: Inspect and operate GitLab through a user-configured remote HTTPS MCP server with OAuth, while keeping localhost available only as an explicit development fallback.

interface.shortDescription: GitLab via configurable remote MCP + OAuth
interface.longDescription: Use GitLab workflow skills with a remote HTTPS MCP server chosen by the user or workspace. The public plugin intentionally embeds no maintainer-specific MCP endpoint: configure your own HTTPS /mcp connection in ChatGPT, Codex, or another compatible MCP client and complete OAuth there. Localhost remains an explicit development fallback only. No second repository or generated remote marketplace is required for the normal direct-MCP setup path.
defaultPrompt: List the GitLab groups and projects I can access.
Review the current GitLab merge request and address feedback.
Create a GitLab issue or merge request after confirming the target.
